series.name: X3 MIC / X3 MIC G2 (hybrid)
series.notes: Official Fronus X3 MIC G2 manual (fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140). Text layer was +31 ASCII cipher — decoded before parse. Named CamelCase fault codes (not numeric). Medium: single official source with cipher-OCR risk. 25 codes.

title.en: Grid voltage out of range / overvoltage for ten minutes

meaning.en: Grid voltage out of range / overvoltage for ten minutes
meaning.ur: Grid voltage range se bahar

causes.en: Grid voltage out of range / overvoltage for ten minutes
causes.ur: Grid voltage range se bahar

causes.en: Utility supply high or low outside the allowed range.
causes.ur: Utility supply allowed range se zyada ya kam ho jana.

causes.en: Input connection loose or the grid sensing wiring damaged.
causes.ur: Input connection dhila ho jana ya grid sensing wiring damage ho jana.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and wait; do not keep restarting while the utility is outside its range.
solutions.ur: Inverter band kar dein aur intezaar karein; utility range se bahar ho to baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: Once the supply is stable, measure the grid voltage with a meter; if it is outside the normal range, check the input terminals and wiring for looseness.
solutions.ur: Supply theek hone par meter se grid voltage naapein; range se bahar ho to input terminal aur wiring ke dhilapan par nazar daalein.

solutions.en: When the utility returns to normal the system reconnects by itself; if it keeps tripping, call a technician.
solutions.ur: Utility normal aate hi system khud connect ho jata hai; baar baar trip ho to technician bulayein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

title.ur: DC injection ki wajah se overcurrent

meaning.ur: Output mein DC injection barh jati hai aur protection chal jati hai.

causes.en: DC injection overcurrent protection
causes.ur: AC output se DC nikalna barh jana

causes.en: Output filter capacitor leaky so DC flows into the AC side.
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor leaky ho jana jis se DC AC side mein chala jaye.

causes.en: Current sensor reading drifts and trips the protection.
causes.ur: Current sensor ki reading hil jaye aur protection trip kar de.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC and isolate the DC source before any testing.
solutions.ur: Testing se pehle AC band kar dein aur DC source alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Use a meter to check the AC output for a DC component and inspect the output filter capacitors and wiring for damage or leaks.
solutions.ur: Meter se AC output mein DC component check karein aur output filter capacitor aur wiring ko damage ya leak ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart once after the check; if the protection trips again, stop and send the unit in for repair.
solutions.ur: Check ke baad ek baar restart karein; protection dobara trip ho to ruk jayein aur unit repair ke liye bhejein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Australian standard ke hard limit par fault aa jana.

causes.en: Hard limit fault (Australian standard)
causes.ur: Australian standard ke hard limit se zyada power nikalna

causes.en: Export or power limit set above the hard limit.
causes.ur: Export ya power limit hard limit se zyada set ho jana.

causes.en: Grid profile or firmware region set to the wrong standard.
causes.ur: Grid profile ya firmware region ghalat standard par set ho jana.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before changing any setting.
solutions.ur: Koi setting badalne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the export/power limit setting against the local standard and confirm the grid profile chosen in the menu.
solutions.ur: Export ya power limit setting ko local standard se compare karein aur menu mein chuna gaya grid profile confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter after correcting the setting; if the fault remains, contact service support.
solutions.ur: Setting theek karke inverter restart karein; fault rahe to service support se rabta karein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Software overcurrent protection chal jati hai.

causes.en: Software overcurrent protection
causes.ur: Load current software limit se zyada hona

causes.en: Output short or a heavy load pulling high current.
causes.ur: Output short ho jana ya bhaari load zyada current khinche.

causes.en: Current sensing circuit reading higher than the actual current.
causes.ur: Current sensing circuit asal se zyada reading de raha ho.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV and grid, and reconnect only after checking the output for shorts.
solutions.ur: PV aur grid alag kar dein aur output mein short check kiye hi phir se connect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the load current with a clamp meter and confirm it is inside the inverter rating; remove any heavy load.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load current naapein aur rating ke andar confirm karein; bhaari load utaar dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect power and wait to see if the inverter returns to normal; if it trips again, call a technician.
solutions.ur: Power wapas lagayein aur dekhein ke inverter normal ho jata hai; dobara trip ho to technician bulayein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Load ka current bohat zyada hona.

causes.en: Over current fault
causes.ur: Load ka current allowed se zyada hona

causes.en: Sudden surge from motors or inductive loads.
causes.ur: Motor ya inductive load ka achanak surge aana.

causes.en: Wiring shorted or a loose joint heating up.
causes.ur: Wiring short ho jana ya dhila joint garam ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the supply before checking the wiring.
solutions.ur: Wiring check karne se pehle band karke supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV and grid, wait about 10 seconds, then use a meter to check the output wiring and joints for shorts or looseness.
solutions.ur: PV aur grid alag karke 10 second intezaar karein, phir meter se output wiring aur joint mein short ya dhilapan check karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect and restart; if the fault returns, reduce the load and have the unit inspected.
solutions.ur: Connect karke restart karein; fault wapas aaye to load kam karke unit check karwaein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Overcurrent protection chal jati hai.

causes.en: Overcurrent protection fault
causes.ur: Residual ya over current bohat zyada hona

causes.en: Leakage to earth through wet or damaged wiring.
causes.ur: Gili ya damaged wiring se earth mein leakage hona.

causes.en: DC switch or output breaker not fully closed.
causes.ur: DC switch ya output breaker theek se band na hona.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and switch off the AC before touching any terminal.
solutions.ur: Terminal chhoone se pehle DC switch kholein aur AC band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the output and earth wiring for leakage or moisture, tighten every connection and measure insulation with a meter if you have one.
solutions.ur: Output aur earth wiring mein leakage ya nami check karein, har connection tight karein aur meter ho to insulation naapein.

solutions.en: Close the DC switch and restart the inverter; if the protection trips again, stop and call a technician.
solutions.ur: DC switch band karke inverter restart karein; protection dobara trip ho to ruk jayein aur technician bulayein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Grid lost / mains gayab

causes.en: Grid lost
causes.ur: Grid lost / mains gayab

causes.en: Utility power cut or the mains breaker tripped.
causes.ur: Utility ka power cut ho jana ya mains breaker trip ho jana.

causes.en: Grid input cable loose at the terminal.
causes.ur: Grid input cable terminal par dhili ho jana.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting; with the supply off, first check the mains cable and breaker.
solutions.ur: Baar baar restart na karein; supply band karke pehle mains cable aur breaker check karein.

solutions.en: Tighten the grid input terminals and use a meter to confirm the utility is actually supplying power.
solutions.ur: Grid input terminal tight karein aur meter se confirm karein ke utility waqai power de rahi hai.

solutions.en: The system reconnects on its own once the utility is normal; if it stays off, contact the utility or a technician.
solutions.ur: Utility normal hote hi system khud connect ho jata hai; band rahe to utility ya technician se rabta karein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Isolation (ISO) fault

causes.en: Isolation fault
causes.ur: Isolation (ISO) fault

causes.en: Moisture or dust on the PV and output wiring.
causes.ur: PV aur output wiring par nami ya dhool hona.

causes.en: Damaged insulation letting leakage current escape.
causes.ur: Insulation damage hona jis se leakage current bahar nikle.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC and isolate the PV before checking insulation.
solutions.ur: Insulation check karne se pehle AC band karein aur PV alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Inspect the PV and output wiring, connectors and inverter terminals for moisture, dust or damaged insulation.
solutions.ur: PV aur output wiring, connector aur inverter terminal mein nami, dhool ya insulation damage check karein.

solutions.en: Dry and repair the wiring, then restart; if the fault remains, the unit needs service.
solutions.ur: Wiring ko sukha karke theek karein aur restart karein; fault rahe to unit ki service zaroori hai.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Inverter ka temperature allowed se zyada hona.

causes.en: Over temperature
causes.ur: Vent block hona ya ambient temperature bohat zyada hona

causes.en: Cooling fan stopped or the heatsink is full of dust.
causes.ur: Cooling fan band ho jana ya heatsink dhool se bhari ho jana.

causes.en: Heavy load running long and heating the unit.
causes.ur: Lambi der bhaari load chalne se unit garam ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and let it cool before working on it.
solutions.ur: Kaam se pehle inverter band karke thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Clear the vents, remove dust from the heatsink and confirm the cooling fan runs when powered.
solutions.ur: Vent saaf karein, heatsink ki dhool hataayein aur power par fan chalne ko confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restore power and watch the temperature; if it climbs again, reduce the load or call a technician.
solutions.ur: Power wapas on karein aur temperature dekhein; phir barhe to load kam karein ya technician bulayein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Ambient temperature allowed se bohat kam hona.

causes.en: Low temperature
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat kam hona

causes.en: Ambient temperature below the allowed start temperature.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature allowed start temperature se neeche ho jana.

causes.en: Temperature sensor reading wrongly low.
causes.ur: Temperature sensor ghalat kam reading de raha ho.

solutions.en: Do not force a start in very cold weather; let the unit warm up first.
solutions.ur: Bohat sardi mein start zabardasti na karein; pehle unit ko garam hone dein.

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature and take the temperature sensor reading with a meter.
solutions.ur: Ambient temperature check karein aur meter se temperature sensor ki reading lein.

solutions.en: When the temperature is back in the normal range, restart the inverter; if the fault stays, have the sensor checked.
solutions.ur: Temperature normal range mein aane par inverter restart karein; fault rahe to sensor check karwaein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Grid frequency range se bahar

causes.en: Grid frequency out of range
causes.ur: Grid frequency range se bahar

causes.en: Utility frequency outside the standard range.
causes.ur: Utility frequency standard range se bahar hona.

causes.en: Weak generator or grid feeding the inverter.
causes.ur: Kamzor generator ya grid inverter ko power de raha ho.

solutions.en: Power off and wait; do not keep restarting while the grid frequency is out of range.
solutions.ur: Power band karke intezaar karein; grid frequency range se bahar ho to baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: Measure the grid frequency with a meter and confirm it matches the standard for your area.
solutions.ur: Meter se grid frequency naapein aur confirm karein ke woh ilaqay ke standard ke mutabiq hai.

solutions.en: The system reconnects when the frequency is normal; if it does not, contact a technician.
solutions.ur: Frequency normal hote hi system connect ho jata hai; na ho to technician se rabta karein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar boards ke darmiyan communication ruk jana.

causes.en: Internal communication fault
causes.ur: Andaruni communication line dhili ya tooti hona

causes.en: Internal board connector not seated properly.
causes.ur: Andaruni board connector theek se na lagna.

causes.en: Software version mismatch between the boards.
causes.ur: Boards ke darmiyan software version match na karna.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the supply before opening it.
solutions.ur: Kholne se pehle inverter band karke supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the internal board connectors and communication wiring for looseness or damage.
solutions.ur: Andaruni board connector aur communication wiring dhilapan ya damage ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter to re-check; if the fault stays, the ARM software may need an update or reburn — send it for service.
solutions.ur: Dobara check ke liye inverter restart karein; fault rahe to ARM software update ya reburn zaroori ho sakta hai — service ke liye bhejein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: PV ka voltage allowed range se bahar hona.

causes.en: PV voltage fault
causes.ur: PV string ka voltage zyada ya kam hona

causes.en: Too many panels in series for the inverter input range.
causes.ur: Series mein inverter input range se zyada panel lagna.

causes.en: Open or loose PV connection.
causes.ur: PV connection khula ya dhila ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the PV before measuring.
solutions.ur: Naapne se pehle PV band karke alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the PV string voltage with a meter and confirm it sits inside the inverter input range.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV string voltage naapein aur confirm karein ke woh inverter ke input range mein hai.

solutions.en: Check the string connections for loose or reversed plugs, then reconnect and restart.
solutions.ur: String connection mein dhila ya ulta plug check karein, phir connect karke restart karein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Fan theek se na chalna.

causes.en: Fan fault
causes.ur: Fan atka hona ya fan kharab hona

causes.en: Fan wiring loose or the fan connector oxidised.
causes.ur: Fan ki wiring dhili ho jana ya connector par carbon lag jana.

causes.en: Fan bearings jammed with dust.
causes.ur: Dhool se fan ki bearing jam ho jana.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before touching the fan.
solutions.ur: Fan chhoone se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check whether the fan is blocked, damaged or not spinning, clean out the dust and check the fan connector.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke fan ruka hua, damage ya ghumta hua nahi hai; dhool saaf karein aur fan connector check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan if it does not turn, restore power and confirm the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Fan na ghumay to fan badlein, power on karein aur fault khatam hona confirm karein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

title.en: DC bus voltage out of normal range
title.ur: DC bus voltage normal range se bahar

meaning.en: DC bus voltage out of normal range
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage normal range se bahar

causes.en: DC bus voltage out of normal range
causes.ur: DC bus voltage normal range se bahar

causes.en: PV or battery input outside the normal range.
causes.ur: PV ya battery input normal range se bahar hona.

causes.en: DC link capacitor failed so the bus cannot hold voltage.
causes.ur: DC link capacitor kharab ho jana, jis ki wajah se bus voltage hold nahi kar pata.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the PV and battery before checking the bus.
solutions.ur: Bus check karne se pehle PV aur battery band karke alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the DC bus and PV input voltage with a meter and confirm both are inside the normal range.
solutions.ur: Meter se DC bus aur PV input voltage naapein aur dono ko normal range mein confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the DC terminals and wiring for looseness, then power up; if the bus is still out of range, call a technician.
solutions.ur: DC terminal aur wiring dhilapan ke liye check karein, phir power on karein; bus phir bhi range se bahar ho to technician bulayein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: AC terminal over-temperature

causes.en: AC terminal overtemperature
causes.ur: AC terminal over-temperature

causes.en: Loose AC terminal joint heating up.
causes.ur: AC terminal ka dhila joint garam ho jana.

causes.en: High ambient temperature or a heavy load running for long.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature zyada hona ya lambi der bhaari load chalna.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and let the terminals cool before touching them.
solutions.ur: Terminal chhoone se pehle inverter band karke terminal ko thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Check that the AC terminals are tight and free of burns, and confirm the ambient temperature is within range.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke AC terminal tight aur jale hue nahi hain, aur ambient temperature range mein hai.

solutions.en: Tighten or replace damaged terminals, restore power and check that the temperature stays normal.
solutions.ur: Damage terminal tight ya badlein, power on karein aur temperature normal rehna confirm karein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: DSP ki EEPROM theek se kaam nahi karna.

causes.en: DSP EEPROM fault
causes.ur: DSP EEPROM data kharab ho jana

causes.en: Power cut while the EEPROM data was being written.
causes.ur: Jab EEPROM ka data likha ja raha tha, us waqt power cut ho gaya.

causes.en: EEPROM chip aged or damaged.
causes.ur: EEPROM chip purani ya damage ho jana.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the supplies before reconnecting any wiring.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi wiring dobara lagane se pehle power band karke supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV wiring and reconnect it firmly, making sure no connector is loose or damaged.
solutions.ur: PV wiring alag karke mazbooti se wapas lagayein aur dekhein ke koi connector dhila ya damage nahi hai.

solutions.en: Power up again; if the fault persists, seek help — the DSP EEPROM may need a service reload.
solutions.ur: Dobara power on karein; fault barqarar rahe to madad lein — DSP EEPROM ko service par dobara load karwana parega.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Residual current device theek se kaam nahi karna.

causes.en: Residual current device fault
causes.ur: Residual current device trip ya kharab hona

causes.en: Earth leakage in the installation wiring.
causes.ur: Installation wiring mein earth leakage hona.

causes.en: Device wiring loose or the device itself failed.
causes.ur: Device ki wiring dhili ho jana ya device hi kharab ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter before checking the device.
solutions.ur: Device check karne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the residual current device wiring and the earth connection, then restart the inverter to re-check.
solutions.ur: Residual current device ki wiring aur earth connection check karein, phir dobara check ke liye inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: If the fault stays, update the ARM software or send the unit in for service.
solutions.ur: Fault rahe to ARM software update karein ya unit service ke liye bhejein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: PV ka connection ulti polarity se lag jana.

causes.en: PV direction / polarity fault
causes.ur: PV positive aur negative ultay lag jana

causes.en: String connectors plugged in reverse.
causes.ur: String connector ulta plug ho jana.

causes.en: Mixed PV strings of opposite polarity.
causes.ur: Alag polarity ki PV strings mix ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the PV before checking polarity.
solutions.ur: Polarity check karne se pehle PV band karke alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Use a meter to check that the PV sides are connected correctly — positive to positive and negative to negative.
solutions.ur: Meter se check karein ke PV sides theek lagin hain — positive positive aur negative negative par.

solutions.en: Correct any reversed connection, then reconnect and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Koi ulta connection theek karke wapas connect karein aur inverter restart karein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Grid relay fault

causes.en: Relay fault
causes.ur: Grid relay fault

causes.en: Relay contacts welded or worn out.
causes.ur: Relay contact chipak jana ya ghis jana.

causes.en: Relay coil supply missing or the wiring loose.
causes.ur: Relay coil ki supply na aaye ya wiring dhili ho jana.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before checking the relay.
solutions.ur: Relay check karne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the grid connection and listen for the relay clicking when the unit starts; check the relay wiring with a meter.
solutions.ur: Grid connection check karein aur unit start hone par relay ki awaaz sunke dekhein; meter se relay wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the relay still does not operate, the unit needs a technician.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; phir bhi relay na chale to unit technician ke paas jaye.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

title.ur: Model ghalat set hone ka fault

meaning.ur: Inverter ka model settings mein ghalat set ho jana.

causes.en: Model incorrectly set fault
causes.ur: Model number ki setting ghalat hona

causes.en: Product type or power rating chosen wrongly in the menu.
causes.ur: Menu mein product type ya power rating ghalat chun lena.

causes.en: Firmware does not match the configured model.
causes.ur: Firmware configured model se match na karna.

solutions.en: Power off before changing the model setting.
solutions.ur: Model setting badalne se pehle power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Open the settings menu and confirm the model or product type matches the nameplate.
solutions.ur: Settings menu kholein aur confirm karein ke model ya product type nameplate se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Save the setting and restart; if the fault remains, seek help from service.
solutions.ur: Setting save karke restart karein; fault rahe to service se madad lein.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: ARM board ki EEPROM theek se kaam nahi karna.

causes.en: ARM EEPROM fault
causes.ur: ARM EEPROM data kharab ho jana

causes.en: Interrupted upgrade left the ARM EEPROM incomplete.
causes.ur: Upgrade ruk jane se ARM EEPROM adhoori reh jana.

causes.en: EEPROM chip on the ARM board failed.
causes.ur: ARM board par lagi EEPROM chip kharab ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the PV and grid before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: Dobara connect karne se pehle PV aur grid band karke alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV and grid, check the connectors, then reconnect them firmly.
solutions.ur: PV aur grid alag karke connector check karein, phir mazbooti se wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Power up and re-check; if the fault stays, the ARM board needs service support.
solutions.ur: Power on karke dobara check karein; fault rahe to ARM board ko service support chahiye.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

meaning.ur: Meter sahi tareeqay se na chalna.

causes.en: Meter fault
causes.ur: Meter kharab hona ya uska connection toot jana

causes.en: Meter communication wiring loose or broken.
causes.ur: Meter ki communication wiring dhili ya tooti ho jana.

causes.en: Meter supply missing or the meter fuse blown.
causes.ur: Meter ki supply na aaye ya meter ka fuse udd jana.

solutions.en: Power off before checking the meter wiring.
solutions.ur: Meter wiring check karne se pehle power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the meter connection and communication line and confirm the meter itself is working.
solutions.ur: Meter connection aur communication line check karein aur confirm karein ke meter khud chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect and restart the inverter; if the fault stays, the meter or its wiring needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Connect karke inverter restart karein; fault rahe to meter ya uski wiring badalni paregi.

source.title: Fronus X3 MIC G2 user manual (official PDF — fronus.com / UAN 042-111-111-140; text layer +31 cipher, decoded)

title.ur: External fan ka normal se hatka warning

meaning.ur: External fan normal tareeqay se nahi chal raha.

causes.en: External fan abnormal warning
causes.ur: External fan atka hona ya kharab hona

solutions.en: Check if the fan is working.
solutions.ur: Manual ke hisaab se check karein; fix na ho to stop.

meaning.ur: Power type setting ghalat hona.

causes.en: Power type fault
causes.ur: Power type settings ghalat hona

causes.en: Grid type or power type set wrongly in the settings.
causes.ur: Settings mein grid ya power type ghalat set ho jana.

causes.en: Firmware or product SN does not match the configured type.
causes.ur: Firmware ya product SN configured type se match na karna.

solutions.en: Power off before checking the version and serial data.
solutions.ur: Version aur serial data check karne se pehle power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the ARM/DSP version and product SN in the menu and confirm they match the configured power type.
solutions.ur: Menu mein ARM/DSP version aur product SN check karein aur confirm karein ke woh configured power type se match karte hain.

solutions.en: Correct the setting and restart; if the fault stays, seek help from service.
solutions.ur: Setting theek karke restart karein; fault rahe to service se madad lein.
